textRuns.value: Margin pressure and throughput drag show a dispersed, non-linear relationship across facilities. Financial stress appears at both high and low excess LOS, and elevated throughput drag does not consistently align with higher margin pressure.

This dispersion reflects heterogeneous structural exposure, not a dominant system-wide relationship, and may be influenced by reimbursement context, including payer mix. The visual shows joint operating context, not performance, impact, or causality.

Each point represents a facility positioned by excess LOS and margin pressure, with reference lines marking the LOS peer median and the all-facilities margin-pressure median. Position indicates relative context within the distribution, not classification.

This view does not adjust for case mix, service mix, market structure, or payer composition and does not support causal inference. Use it only as joint-context baseline to interpret downstream financial or capacity metrics, not as a diagnostic endpoint.
